scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Sodium carbonate dissolving
experiments.focus: Show a common carbonate salt dissolving to form a clear alkaline solution.
student_observations: Some salts can make solutions feel different from pure water.
experiments.teacher_note: This is a classroom-level solubility example only.

experiments.title: Calcium chloride dissolving
experiments.focus: Show a very soluble salt dissolving rapidly in the model.
student_observations: Dissolving is still a physical change.
experiments.teacher_note: Use the model to discuss why some salts dissolve faster than others.

experiments.title: Potassium chloride dissolving
experiments.focus: Introduce another soluble salt for comparison with sodium salts.
student_observations: Different salts can have similar classroom behavior.
experiments.teacher_note: Useful as a comparison point after sodium chloride.

experiments.title: Precipitation concept
experiments.focus: Show how two clear solutions can produce a white solid in the classroom model.
student_observations: A white solid appears in the model.
Not all reaction products stay dissolved.
experiments.teacher_note: Discuss the idea of a precipitate without giving a real lab procedure.
